description: Process A holds a snapshot, a dynaset and a table-type recordset on T, each positioned on row 1, and a TableDef object. Process B tries DROP TABLE T, then ALTER TABLE T ADD COLUMN W LONG; A then moves each recordset one row, closes the snapshot; B tries DROP TABLE T again; A closes the others; B tries a last DROP TABLE T. Errors, catalogs and A's reads after each step.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
